metaDescription: Maximize the value of your initial financial advisory session in Nepal. Complete preparation checklist covering financial statements, tax records, and goals.
h1: What to Prepare Before Your First Financial Consultation
directAnswer: To maximize the outcome of your first financial consultation, prepare your last 12-24 months of audited financial statements (or management accounts), recent bank statements for all operational accounts, current VAT/PAN filing slips, an aged accounts receivable/payable summary, and a clear list of your primary commercial objectives (e.g., loan financing, cost reduction, or runway extension).
author: Lalitpur Advisory Research Desk

sections.contentHtml:
Bringing organized source records enables our senior consultants to diagnose underlying operational dynamics during your very first meeting:

  • Audited Balance Sheets & P&L: The previous 2 fiscal years filed with the Inland Revenue Department (IRD).
  • Recent Management Accounts: YTD trial balance, sales register, and purchase register exports.
  • Commercial Bank Statements: Last 6 months of bank statements across all operating accounts.
  • Debt & Loan Schedules: Active bank credit agreements (working capital, term loans, hypothecation) including EMI schedules and interest rates.
  • Tax Clearance Status: Most recent Tax Clearance Certificate issued by your local IRO.

sections.h2: Essential Document Checklist for Individuals & Families
sections.contentHtml:
For private wealth and personal budgeting consultations, gather:

  • Monthly net salary slips and secondary income receipts (freelance, rent, dividends).
  • Estimated monthly household living expenses (housing, groceries, children's school fees).
  • Details of existing liabilities: home loans, auto loans, personal bank borrowings.
  • Social Security Fund (SSF) and Citizen Investment Trust (CIT) deduction slips.

Arrive with defined questions: 'How do we resolve our cash crunch before Dashain?' or 'Can we afford to open a second branch in Pokhara?' Ready to begin? Explore our financial consultancy services in Nepal to schedule your session.

faqs.question: What if our books are messy and incomplete?
faqs.answer: Do not worry—diagnosing and cleaning up unorganized ledgers is one of the most common reasons businesses approach our advisory desk. Bring whatever statements and records you possess.
